title: EnableLinkChain - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script This function enables all the linked refs, linked in a chain, from this reference (but not this reference). Does not wait for all the references to fade in or enable before returning. Syntax: Function EnableLinkChain(Keyword apKeyword = None, bool abFadeIn = false) native Parameters: - apKeyword: Keyword to check ref link against (see GetLinkedRef.) Default: None - abFadeIn: If true, will fade in the references. Otherwise they will pop in. Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable every ref linked to startRef in a chain startRef.EnableLinkChain()
; Enable every ref linked to startRef using the special keyword startRef.EnableLinkChain(SpecialKeyword) See Also: - ObjectReference Script - Enable - ObjectReference - GetLinkedRef - ObjectReference
